# Asterisk iPhone Bluetooth Gateway Troubleshooting Lab
> Evidence-led diagnostic cases, patches and tests; no private production state.

- [Start](README.md): architecture, verified outcomes and limits.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): safe navigation and evidence rules.
- [Symptom index](docs/INDEX.md): symptom → cause → fix → reproduction.
- [Structured cases](docs/issues.json): JSON records with evidence level and source paths.
- [Phone quirks](docs/DEVICE-QUIRKS.md): iPhone MAP permission, SCO, Linphone UI, T780P glyphs.
- [Build/test](docs/BUILD-AND-TEST.md): offline checks versus device tests.
- [Scripts](docs/SCRIPT-INVENTORY.md): source inventory and side effects.
- [Publication/privacy](docs/PUBLICATION.md): what was excluded and residual limitations.
